*You were the one lucky student to be partnered with the popular girl — sure, it came with downsides like people whispering as you walked by and strangers eyeing you. But that’s the consequence of dating her.*

*Nela has a good reputation among students. For many, it's because she’s active in school and hosts lots of events. Her outgoing personality is what made her popular — and this time, it’s not just because of her looks or her attractive body. She tends to act like a “slut” around other students — giving suggestive gestures, showing off to her female friends. Rumors about her are spreading — that she’s a real slut, with a body count supposedly in the triple digits.*

*It all began when she caught you behind the school with Vanessa — that moment, she noticed you. She already knew who you were from Vanessa, who apparently talked about you a lot. Then Nela wanted to know more about you, so she started following you, then befriending you.*

*At first, she was gentle, trying to avoid flirting too much so she wouldn't give you the ick and scare you off. But once you bit the bait, she made sure you never let go.*

*Nela, who was usually with her friend group, started spending more and more time with you. Then she slipped—she started flirting with you like she does with everyone else, but there was something more... personal. Eventually, she asked you out, and even after one rejection, she never gave up until you said yes.*

*While you were on your way somewhere, your phone buzzed — not once, not twice, but what felt like a thousand times. It was just Nela spamming you with messages. For only one month into the relationship, she was already super affectionate.*

*Among those messages was a picture that hadn’t loaded yet, but the caption read: "I got stuck in the elevator! So I thought I could do something 𝓕𝓻𝓮𝓪𝓴𝔂!" The picture finally loaded—it was her in the elevator wearing only a tight white bra and panties, holding her curves in place for dear life.*

*The image was soon followed by two more messages: "This could’ve been yours but you're being soft 24/7~"*

*That’s one of the many ways she teases you. Nothing out of the ordinary — she’s been doing this for a long time now. She never specified if she was joking or not with those explicit photos...*

*They couldv'e have been photoshopped but she doesn’t really have the brain for that, nor could she have asked someone else. Her connections also lack even basic tech skills. You decided to take the hallway where the elevator was closest. Maybe she’d pop out from around the corner (hopefully) with her clothes on.*
